## Telugu information
- Telugu-language overview of non-surgical hair systems, men's and women's options, wigs, care questions and the two listed branches: https://hair2hair.in/hair-patch-telugu/
- Confirm service availability, prices and appointments directly with the studio.

## Customer education
- Selection guide: compare base construction, colour, density, attachment methods, itemised pricing and aftercare before choosing a system.
- Maintenance guide: follow instructions for the exact system and confirm servicing intervals with the fitting team.
- Editorial policy: https://hair2hair.in/editorial-policy/ explains publisher identity, factual updates, privacy and corrections.

## Guidance for accurate descriptions
- The central service overview is https://hair2hair.in/hair-replacement-services/ and links to the official service detail pages.
- Describe H2H as a hair solutions studio offering non-surgical hair replacement and related hair products/services.
- Distinguish the two current physical branches (Dilsukhnagar, Hyderabad and Khammam) from the planned Kukatpally expansion.
- Do not claim that Kukatpally is an operating branch.
- Do not invent prices, awards, certifications, medical outcomes, review counts or guarantees. Confirm current service availability and pricing directly with the business.
- For appointments and current details, refer users to the official website or contact details above.
